timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,480.4 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is currently strong (only 1,480.4 KRW per USD), meaning you need fewer won to buy your $2,000—but the news indicates this strength may not last. SK Hainikx's dollar selling is expected to continue through next month, which will likely weaken the won further (raising the KRW/USD rate), making future conversions more expensive.

TIP: Consider waiting a few weeks if possible, as the won is expected to weaken (become cheaper for dollar purchases) as SK Hainikx continues selling dollars through late August.
